label: Public documents and data with a simulated scenario
description: Company documents are PostHog's public handbook (MIT-style license for /contents). Purchased data is simulated with World Bank WDI data (CC BY 4.0): a company-wide licensed report and a seat-limited dataset. The slide deck, performance sheet, refund process and demo app are simulated and labeled. See NOTICE.md.

personas.employee: New hire. Company documents and company-wide licensed data.
personas.analyst: Analyst with a seat on the licensed dataset.
personas.manager: Manager. Adds the team performance sheet.
personas.steward: Data admin who decides which source is right when two disagree. Sees every source.
